A '''Velabri Bloodvow''' was an honorable practice among the [[Velabri (species)|Velabri]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. After [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] saved the live of [[Quillin Durand]]'s family during the [[Invasion of Velabri|invasion]] of [[Velabri]], Durand swore a Bloodvow to repay the debt. Although Durand died before he could repay the vow, it was taken up by his eldest son, [[Quillin Arkell]]. Arkell repaid the debt to Cracken by assisting [[Cryle Cavv]] during the extraction of [[Rivoche Tarkin]] from [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>
